mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CLASS ( CLASS_IDX, PROVIDER_IDX, TITLE, INTRO, MINOR_FIELD_IDX, MINOR_REGION_IDX, PRICE, PHOTO, VIDEO, START_DATE, END_DATE, CREATED_AT, MAX_USER_CNT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CLASS.NEXTVAL, #{provider_idx}, #{title}, #{intro}, #{minor_field_idx}, #{minor_region_idx}, #{price}, #{photo}, #{video}, #{start_date}, #{end_date}, SYSDATE, #{max_user_cnt} )
mapper.select: SELECT MAJOR_FIELD_IDX, MAJOR_FIELD_CD FROM MAJOR_FIELD ORDER BY MAJOR_FIELD_IDX
SELECT MINOR_FIELD_IDX, MINOR_FIELD_NM FROM MINOR_FIELD WHERE MAJOR_FIELD_IDX = #{major_field_idx} ORDER BY MINOR_FIELD_NM
SELECT MAJOR_REGION_IDX, REGION_NM FROM MAJOR_REGION ORDER BY MAJOR_REGION_IDX
SELECT MINOR_REGION_IDX, DISTRICT_NM FROM MINOR_REGION WHERE MAJOR_REGION_IDX = #{major_region_idx} ORDER BY DISTRICT_NM

SELECT CLASS_IDX, PROVIDER_IDX, TITLE, INTRO, MINOR_FIELD_IDX, MINOR_REGION_IDX, PRICE, PHOTO, VIDEO, START_DATE, END_DATE, CREATED_AT, MAX_USER_CNT FROM CLASS WHERE PROVIDER_IDX = #{provider_idx} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT CLASS_IDX, PROVIDER_IDX, TITLE, INTRO, MINOR_FIELD_IDX, MINOR_REGION_IDX, PRICE, PHOTO, VIDEO, START_DATE, END_DATE, CREATED_AT, MAX_USER_CNT FROM CLASS WHERE CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx}

SELECT e.ENROLL_IDX, e.CLASS_IDX, e.USER_IDX, e.STATUS, e.ENROLLED_AT, e.COMPLETED_AT, u.USER_NAME, CASE WHEN c.COACH_IDX IS NOT NULL THEN c.PHONE WHEN co.COMPANY_IDX IS NOT NULL THEN co.PHONE ELSE NULL END AS PHONE FROM CLASS_ENROLLMENT e INNER JOIN USERS u ON e.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN COACH c ON u.USER_IDX = c.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN COMPANY co ON u.USER_IDX = co.USER_IDX WHERE e.CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx} ORDER BY e.ENROLLED_AT DESC
